Screen

Full colour in 4 screens. On a dark shirt: white base + cyan, magenta, yellow (the shirt is the black). On a light shirt: C, M, Y, K.

Unticked = knockout: every spot gets exactly one tone, which saves ink.

On a dark shirt with a white base, the base is one of these screens.
